ambiguous options repaired: rewritten as a movement-nature matching item with one right pair (tides = periodic rise and fall)

fix.s: Which of the following pairs (movement of ocean water – its nature) is correctly matched?
o: Tides – Periodic rise and fall of sea level caused mainly by the Moon and the Sun
Currents – Oscillatory movement of water with no forward flow
Waves – Continuous directed flow of water over long distances
fix.x: Tides are the periodic rise and fall of sea level caused mainly by the gravity of the Moon and the Sun (and can be harnessed as tidal energy). Currents are a continuous directed flow of water, waves are an oscillatory movement, and irregular weather-driven surges are storm surges, not tides.
